description: This code defines the BasketQueryService class which implements IBasketQueryService. It provides functionality to query basket data from the database, specifically to count total basket items for a given user.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Implements IBasketQueryService to perform database queries related to baskets, such as counting total items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates the total number of items in a user's basket by summing quantities directly in the database.
